entities.name: Françoise Balibar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Françoise Balibar is a French physicist and science historian, a professor emeritus at Paris Diderot University. She has extensively published works on Albert Einstein, the theory of relativity, and the history and epistemology of physics.
